Production illustration asset for the FaceMarket shooting guide. The attached image is the APPROVED CHARACTER AND STYLE reference, not a layout to copy. Preserve exactly this attractive Korean ADULT woman in her twenties, fair ivory-peach skin, expressive dark eyes, black mid-high ponytail, sculpted matte 3D clay forms, blue-gray crewneck shirt, adult proportions. No jewellery, glasses, hats, no extra people. Consistent identity, facial geometry, hair tie position and clothes across every panel. Soft sculpted hair with broad grooves, no realistic strands or photoreal human skin. All images are eye-level head and upper-chest portraits. Keep ENTIRE head and ponytail visible, about 8% top safety margin. Each face is centered within its cell with identical framing and scale. Do not copy any labels from the reference. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, titles, badges, icons or captions. No decorative frames. These are final textless bitmap assets for a real application, captions will be real HTML outside the image.
Create a SQUARE 1536x1536 texture atlas, EXACTLY three columns by three rows, nine equal square cells. Cells abut with ZERO spacing, ZERO external margin, ZERO borders or dividers, each exactly one-third of canvas width and height. Every cell has the same plain pale cool gray-blue background. NO HEADER, FOOTER, MARGINS, OR CAPTIONS.
All nine portraits use exactly identical soft even outdoor-shade lighting, identical height, level chin and relaxed neutral CLOSED mouth except the one smile.
Cell order, reading left to right:
ROW1 COL1: exact frontal neutral expression, eyes look directly forward.
ROW1 COL2: exact frontal pose, gentle closed-mouth smile, eyes open and directly forward.
ROW1 COL3: head rotated 35 degrees toward image LEFT, both eyes visible, neutral expression.
ROW2 COL1: repeat exact frontal neutral portrait from row1col1, same lighting, head and chin fixed.
ROW2 COL2: head, nose and shoulders EXACTLY frontal as row2col1, neutral closed mouth; ONLY BOTH EYEBALLS move distinctly toward image LEFT. Show sclera to image right of each dark iris. The NOSE STILL POINTS STRAIGHT FORWARD. No head turn.
ROW2 COL3: head, nose and shoulders EXACTLY frontal as row2col1, neutral closed mouth; ONLY BOTH EYEBALLS move distinctly toward image RIGHT. Show sclera to image left of each dark iris. The NOSE STILL POINTS STRAIGHT FORWARD. No head turn.
ROW3 COL1: exact 90-degree full profile facing image LEFT, nose left, only one eye visible, neutral CLOSED mouth, no smile. Ponytail extends behind toward image right.
ROW3 COL2: exact 90-degree full profile facing image RIGHT, nose right, only one eye visible, neutral CLOSED mouth, no smile. Ponytail extends behind toward image left.
ROW3 COL3: complete straight-on REAR view, back of head and centered ponytail, back of shoulders. Absolutely NO face, eyes or nose.
No scene or objects behind the portraits. Grid boundaries must be exactly at 1/3 and 2/3 of the image.
